title: Obsidian Glass
description: Black obsidian glass and antique gold, with the bars where Classic has them. Cracks spread from the score as a player falls behind and a comeback mends them, embers rise off a plate on a winning streak, and the loser's plate shatters like glass at the end of the set. Full-screen VS and Victory in dark glass and gold, and its own Top 8, bracket and standings screens.
